pets.name: Fog Moth
pets.description: A pale moth that circles your shoulder and glows near cursed objects.

pets.name: Lantern Crab
pets.description: A tiny spectral crab carrying a cold blue lantern.

pets.name: Grave Crow
pets.description: A watchful crow that never seems to blink.

pets.name: Mire Slime
pets.description: A cheerful little swamp blob that bounces through the fog.

pets.name: Storm Bat
pets.description: A charged bat that crackles softly before bad weather.

pets.name: Little Leviathan
pets.description: A miniature abyssal spirit that swims through the air beside you.
